parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Required. Dimension: brand | sku | supplier | sales_channel | product_type | sub_sales_channel | customer_tags. customer_tags fans out — an order counts toward each of its customer's tags — and the grand total is deduplicated. customer_tags does not require attribute_id.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Required. Time interval: day | week | month | quarter | year

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional. Number of periods to return
